pr.title: Record the pairing check run after merge
pr.head: 8209556b266d7bc79343052e6f188269ac49b41f

summary: Agent pairing copies the relay key between machines through encrypted text and terminal confirmation. The completed project deferred a real two-machine check until after merge; this change records that check as passed on release 0.9.7.
The added outcome reports matching request fingerprints and key IDs, keychain storage, and the relay returning with no queued or rejected work. It changes no commands, code, or project status.

groups.title: Record the two-machine pairing result
groups.kicker: Close the deferred check in the completed plan
intro: The pairing project leaves its manual validation result in its outcome so a reader can see what was exercised after shipping. Section 8 now records the dated terminal sequence for creating, granting, and accepting the key on two machines.

files.note: Append the successful manual pairing result to section 8 without changing the completed project’s metadata or numbered sections.

checks.text: Project checks pass, and project show reports agent-messages/pairing as completed.
The two-machine run is reported evidence from the outcome; this review did not repeat it or read a real relay key.
The recorded fingerprints, confirmation prompts, encrypted response prefix, and key ID outputs match the current join/grant/show implementations and CLI reference.
